title: Asymmetric bilateral Bailey pairs and Rogers-Ramanujan type identities
summary: The theory of Bailey's transform provides a systematic method for deriving $q$-identities, the key factor of which is the Bailey pair. The concept of Bailey pair was first extended to bilateral version by Paule. In this paper, following Rogers' work on Fourier series, we derive two asymmetric bilateral Bailey pairs. By inserting them into the bilateral Bailey chains, we obtain several identities of Rogers-Ramanujan type, Andrews-Gordon type and also identities on false theta functions.
